Cam (PM): quick heads-up — i'm finalizing a compact GA operability floor (SLA, monitoring, runbooks, support routing, pricing floor). locking at shiproom 15:00 PT unless there are hard no-ships.

Ivy (Eng): I'll own perf SLO validation and the autoscale smoke harness. scope: p95 <= 200ms for <=32-token requests on standard model families. note: long-sequence NVLink mem-frag remains tech-debt; will ship with documented warning.

Harold (SRE): i'll own synthetic canaries, p99 tail alerts, runbooks and the model-fallback playbook. blocking for me: we need a CI-playbooked regional-failover drill and a test that validates fallback to quantized model under load. both must be green before i sign off the runbooks.

Olga (FinOps): i'll publish the GA pricing floor (hosted per-token, embeddings, reserved-commit examples) and two example commit scenarios for sales. enterprise discounts will be finalized next week; GA can ship with a "enterprise tiers pending" note.

ship-bot: created task OPS-5001 (canary-ci) -> Harold; OPS-5002 (autoscale-smoke) -> Ivy.

Cam (PM): proposed minimal GA acceptance checklist (reply :thumbsup: to accept or call out an absolute blocker):

```
GA MINIMAL OPERABILITY FLOOR (owners)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime; Hosted 99.5% initial (owner: Cam)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 by model family; infra target p95 <=200ms for <=32-token requests (owner: Ivy)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness) + p99 tail/queue alerts (owner: Harold)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks + model-fallback & throttling procedures (owner: Harold)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Ivy/Harold)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations page (owner: Cam)
- Support: business-hours triage + documented SEV1 escalation (owner: Cam)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commits; enterprise tiers pending review (owner: Olga)
```

Harold (SRE): blocking items repeated: regional failover CI + fallback-under-load test.

Ivy (Eng): will push autoscale smoke by Wed; KV-cache cold-start test in follow-up.

Olga (FinOps): draft price floor by Fri.

Cam (PM): locking this for the shiproom deck at 15:00 PT unless someone calls an absolute blocker in this thread. thanks all.
